title: Leases
description: The leases of your organization. A lease starts from a unit.
unitDescription: The leases of this unit. A new lease starts as a draft.
refused: The action could not be completed.

invalid.role: Choose the role of each person.
invalid.name: Enter the name of each person.
invalid.share: The share of the rent must be a percentage, for example 50 or 33.33.
invalid.amount: The maximum amount must be in dollars, for example 1500 or 1500.50.

refusals.shares: The shares of the rent must add up to 100%.
refusals.tenantRequired: A lease has at least one tenant.
refusals.contactRequired: Enter an email or a phone number for each tenant and guarantor.
refusals.emailInvalid: One of the emails is not valid.
refusals.nameRequired: Enter the name of each person.
refusals.tooMany: There are too many people on this lease.
refusals.afterSigning: After signing, tenants and guarantors can no longer change here. See "Lease events". Occupants can still be added or removed.
refusals.unknownTenant: A guarantor covers a tenant who is not on the lease.
refusals.notFound: This lease does not exist, or it does not belong to your organization.
refusals.unitNotFound: This unit does not exist, or it does not belong to your organization.
refusals.occupantNotFound: This occupant is not on the lease.

solidarity.title: Responsibility of the tenants
solidarity.help: With several tenants, choose whether each answers for the whole rent (solidary) or only for their share (joint).

parties.title: Parties to the lease
parties.description: Tenants, occupants and guarantors. People without an account are invited later.

occupants.title: Occupants
occupants.description: An occupant can be added or removed at any time, even after signing.
